descriptions.preferred: Acer palmatum 'Yellow Threads' Rare Buchholz Nursery Introduction Japanese Maple Zones 5-9 'Yellow Threads' is perhaps one of the newest selections from Buchholz Nursery. The yellow-green spring color is stunning on thin strap-like leaves. According to Talon's site, 'Yellow Threads' develops a broad canopy, but makes a nice mid-size tree reaching 8 ft in height by 6 ft in width in 10 years. Fall color doesn't disappoint with bright yellow and orange. Only a limited number of these available. Get one before they are gone! descriptions_zh.preferred: Acer palmatum 'Yellow Threads' 稀有 Buchholz Nursery 引种日本枫，适生区 5-9。'Yellow Threads' 可能是 Buchholz Nursery 最新选育品种之一。其春季叶色呈黄绿色，细长如带状的叶片观赏性极佳。根据 Talon 网站的信息，'Yellow Threads' 可形成较宽的树冠，但整体仍属中型树，10 年约高 8 英尺、宽 6 英尺。秋色同样出色，可呈鲜亮的黄色和橙色。现有数量有限，售完即止。带有 MrMaple 标识的照片归 MrMaple.com 所有，未经明确书面许可不得使用。本页未带 MrMaple 标识的照片由 Talon Buchholz 拍摄，未经所有者明确书面许可不得使用。数量有限。由于我们拥有上千个日本枫品种，每个品种通常库存不多，建议尽快购买心仪品种，因为部分选育品种经常很快售罄。
